result.title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
result.summary: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了从 agent 自身轨迹中挖掘 lessons、再整合为带合并计数的 guidelines 的记忆自蒸馏流水线，在 AppWorld 上跨基线 40–92% 的多个模型比较全量与子集记忆，发现合适的记忆量取决于模型本身，并总结部署中的失败教训。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按模型容量决定状态保留量并在推理期选择子集」与「从自身轨迹蒸馏经验」的做法，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态预算、视觉证据筛选与轨迹监督提供可核查线索；但属纯文本 agent 记忆，无视觉实验。
